verdict.rationale: Statsig documents Dynamic Configs as a first-class entity alongside boolean Feature Gates. They can be retrieved via the HTTP API, scoped by target app, evaluated per environment, and managed via the CLI. The founders describe them as "realtime targeted config", and experiments serve different variants to groups. The evidence never states what value types Dynamic Configs hold, and Feature Gates themselves return only pass/fail. missing for 10: explicit documentation of string/number/JSON value types for dynamic configs, documented multivariate flag variants outside experiments, SDK getter examples for typed values, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans
